source.text: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ὑπὲρ τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡμῶν ἐπισυναγωγῆς ἐπ’ αὐτόν, εἰς τὸ μὴ ταχέως σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε δι’ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς δι’ ἡμῶν, ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ κυρίου.

records.literal_gloss: We ask now you, brothers, concerning the coming of the Lord of us Jesus Christ and of our gathering together to him, \v 2 for the not quickly to be shaken you from the mind nor to be alarmed, neither through spirit nor through word nor through letter as through us, as that has come the day of the Lord.

en.L: Now we ask you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} and our being gathered together to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 2 not to be quickly shaken from [your] mind or alarmed, either by a spirit or by a word or by a letter as if from us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come.
en.B: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, we have a request about the coming of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} and our gathering to meet {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 2 Do not let yourselves be quickly shaken out of your senses or thrown into alarm by a prophetic word, a spoken message or a letter that claims to come from us, saying that the day of the Lord is already here.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, we want to talk to you about when our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} comes back and gathers us to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. \v 2 Some people may say that the day of the Lord has already come. Do not be quick to get upset or worried by this, even if someone says it came from the Spirit, or from something we said, or from a letter we wrote.

fr.L: Or nous vous demandons, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, au sujet de la venue de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et de notre rassemblement auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 2 de ne pas vous laisser trop vite ébranler dans votre raison ni effrayer, ni par un esprit, ni par une parole, ni par une lettre comme venant de nous, selon laquelle le jour du Seigneur est là.
fr.B: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, nous avons une demande à vous faire au sujet de la venue de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} et de notre rassemblement pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rencontrer. \v 2 Ne vous laissez pas trop vite troubler l’esprit ni effrayer par une parole prophétique, un message oral ou une lettre qui prétendrait venir de nous, selon lesquels le jour du Seigneur serait déjà là.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, nous voulons vous parler du moment où notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} reviendra et nous rassemblera auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \v 2 Certains diront peut-être que le jour du Seigneur est déjà venu. Ne vous laissez pas vite troubler ou inquiéter par cela, même si quelqu’un dit que cela vient de l’Esprit, ou de quelque chose que nous avons dit, ou d’une lettre que nous avons écrite.

es.L: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:les|os}} rogamos, hermanos, con respecto a la venida de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} y a nuestra reunión con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 2 que no {{plural_you:se dejen|os dejéis}} sacudir tan pronto en el modo de pensar ni alarmar, ni por espíritu, ni por palabra, ni por carta como si fuera nuestra, en el sentido de que el día del Señor ya ha llegado.
es.B: Hermanos, tenemos un ruego acerca de la venida de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} y de nuestra reunión con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 2 No {{plural_you:se dejen|os dejéis}} perturbar tan fácilmente ni alarmar por una palabra profética, un mensaje hablado o una carta que dice venir de nosotros, según la cual el día del Señor ya está aquí.
es.R: Hermanos, queremos hablar{{plural_you:les|os}} de cuándo nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} volverá y nos reunirá con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 2 Puede que algunos digan que el día del Señor ya llegó. No {{plural_you:se preocupen|os preocupéis}} ni {{plural_you:se asusten|os asustéis}} enseguida por eso, aunque alguien diga que lo ha recibido del Espíritu, o de algo que dijimos, o de una carta que escribimos.

sw.L: Basi tunawaomba, ndugu, kuhusu kuja kwa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na kukusanywa kwetu pamoja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, \v 2 msitikiswe upesi akilini wala msitishwe, iwe kwa roho au kwa neno au kwa barua kana kwamba imetoka kwetu, kwamba siku ya Bwana imekwisha kufika.
sw.B: Ndugu, tuna ombi kuhusu kuja kwa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na kukusanywa kwetu ili tumlaki. \v 2 Msikubali kutikiswa upesi mkapoteza akili zenu, wala kushtushwa na ujumbe wa kinabii, au neno la mdomo, au barua inayodaiwa kutoka kwetu, ikisema kwamba siku ya Bwana imekwisha kufika.
sw.R: Ndugu, tunataka kuzungumza nanyi kuhusu wakati Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} atakaporudi na kutukusanya {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. \v 2 Huenda watu wengine wakasema kwamba siku ya Bwana imekwisha kufika. Msiwe wepesi kufadhaika au kuwa na wasiwasi kwa sababu ya jambo hilo, hata kama mtu atasema limetoka kwa Roho, au kwa jambo tulilosema, au kwa barua tuliyoandika.

decisions.choice: our gathering together to him
decisions.reason: ἐπισυναγωγῆς is the gathering of believers to the Lord at his coming, which 1 Thessalonians 4:17 describes; Jesus used the related verb of the angels gathering his chosen ones (Mark 13:27).

decisions.choice: a spirit: a prophetic utterance claiming to come from the Spirit
decisions.reason: πνεύματος here is a message given in the church as from the Spirit (1 Thessalonians 5:19-21, where such words are to be tested).

decisions.choice: as if from us: someone was claiming Paul's authority
alternatives: a genuine letter of Paul's misunderstood
decisions.reason: ὡς δι ἡμῶν goes at least with "letter" and perhaps with all three. Someone may have passed on a letter falsely claiming to be Paul's, which would explain why he signs this one so carefully (3:17), or misread his first letter.

decisions.choice: has come: is already here
decisions.reason: ἐνίστημι in the perfect means "has arrived, is present" (Romans 8:38, "things present"). The false claim was not that the day was near, which Paul himself taught, but that it had already come.

decisions.choice: shaken and alarmed
decisions.reason: σαλευθῆναι is to be shaken like a ship in a storm; θροεῖσθαι is to be startled, thrown into alarm (Mark 13:7).

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The letter is to the whole church, women and men; "brothers" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: a prophetic word, a spoken message or a letter (B); from the Spirit, ... from something we said, or from a letter we wrote (R)
alternatives: a spirit, a word, a letter
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "a spirit" means here (m2).

decisions.choice: por espíritu, por palabra, por carta (L); una palabra profética, un mensaje hablado o una carta (B)
decisions.reason: "Spirit" here is a prophetic utterance claiming to come from the Spirit (meaning decision); Literal keeps the bare "espíritu", Balanced says what it was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: ya ha llegado (L); ya está aquí (B); ya llegó (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means "is already present" (meaning decision, footnoted), not "is near".

decisions.choice: kwa roho (L); ujumbe wa kinabii (B)
decisions.reason: The "spirit" here is a prophetic utterance claiming to come from the Spirit (meaning decision), so Literal writes "roho" lowercase and Balanced says "ujumbe wa kinabii" (a prophetic message). Readable names the claim ("limetoka kwa Roho"), as the English Readable does.

source.text: μή τις ὑμᾶς ἐξαπατήσῃ κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον· ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ ἔλθῃ ἡ ἀποστασία πρῶτον καὶ ἀποκαλυφθῇ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας, ὁ ἀντικείμενος καὶ ὑπεραιρόμενος ἐπὶ πάντα λεγόμενον θεὸν ἢ σέβασμα, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καθίσαι ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἔστιν θεός.

records.literal_gloss: Not anyone you should deceive in any way; because unless comes the rebellion first and is revealed the man of the lawlessness, the son of the destruction, \v 4 the [one] opposing and exalting himself over every so-called god or object of worship, so that he in the temple of the God sits, showing himself that he is God.

en.L: Let no one deceive you in any way, because [that day will not come] unless the rebellion comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction, \v 4 who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, displaying himself as being God.
en.B: No one must lead you astray, whatever they say. Before that day comes, the great rebellion must first take place, and the man of lawlessness must be unveiled, the one doomed to destruction. \v 4 He will set himself against every so-called god and everything people worship, and lift himself above them all, until he takes his seat in God's temple and presents himself as God.
en.R: Do not let anyone fool you in any way. That day will not come until there is a great rebellion against God, and until the man who rebels against all of God's laws appears. He is headed for destruction. \v 4 He will fight against everything that people call a god or worship. He will say he is greater than all of them. He will even sit in God's temple and say that he is God.

fr.L: Que personne ne vous trompe d’aucune manière, car [ce jour ne viendra pas] si la rébellion ne vient pas d’abord et si l’homme de l’iniquité n’est pas révélé, le fils de la perdition, \v 4 celui qui s’oppose et s’élève au-dessus de tout ce qu’on appelle dieu ou qu’on adore, au point de s’asseoir dans le temple de Dieu, se présentant lui-même comme étant Dieu.
fr.B: Que personne ne vous égare, quoi qu’on vous dise. Avant que ce jour vienne, il faut d’abord que la grande rébellion ait lieu et que l’homme sans loi soit dévoilé, celui qui est voué à la perdition. \v 4 Il se dressera contre tout ce qu’on appelle dieu et tout ce que les gens adorent, et il s’élèvera au-dessus de tout, jusqu’à s’asseoir dans le temple de Dieu et à se présenter comme Dieu.
fr.R: Ne laissez personne vous tromper d’aucune façon. Ce jour-là ne viendra pas avant qu’il y ait une grande révolte contre Dieu, et avant que paraisse l’homme qui méprise toutes les lois de Dieu. Cet homme va vers sa destruction. \v 4 Il luttera contre tout ce que les gens appellent un dieu ou adorent. Il dira qu’il est plus grand qu’eux tous. Il ira même s’asseoir dans le temple de Dieu, et il dira qu’il est Dieu.

es.L: Que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} engañe de ninguna manera, porque [ese día no vendrá] sin que primero venga la rebelión y se manifieste el hombre de la iniquidad, el hijo de la perdición, \v 4 el que se opone y se exalta por encima de todo lo que se llama dios o es objeto de culto, hasta el punto de sentarse en el templo de Dios, presentándose como si fuera Dios.
es.B: Que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} engañe, digan lo que digan. Antes de que llegue ese día, tiene que venir primero la gran rebelión y manifestarse el hombre de la maldad, el que está destinado a la destrucción. \v 4 Él se opondrá a todo lo que se llama dios y a todo lo que la gente adora, y se pondrá por encima de todo ello, hasta sentarse en el templo de Dios y presentarse como Dios.
es.R: No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} engañe de ninguna manera. Ese día no llegará hasta que haya una gran rebelión contra Dios y aparezca el hombre que se rebela contra todas las leyes de Dios. Ese hombre va camino de la destrucción. \v 4 Luchará contra todo lo que la gente llama dios o adora. Dirá que es más grande que todos ellos. Hasta se sentará en el templo de Dios y dirá que él es Dios.

sw.L: Mtu yeyote asiwadanganye kwa namna yoyote; kwa sababu [siku ile haitakuja] isipokuwa ukengeufu utokee kwanza na afunuliwe yule mtu wa uasi, mwana wa maangamizi, \v 4 yeye anayepinga na kujiinua juu ya kila kinachoitwa mungu au kinachoabudiwa, hata yeye aketi katika hekalu la Mungu, akijionyesha kwamba yeye ni Mungu.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote asiwapotoshe, kwa njia yoyote ile. Kabla siku ile haijafika, ni lazima kwanza ukengeufu mkuu utokee, na yule mtu wa uasi afunuliwe, yule aliyehukumiwa kuangamia. \v 4 Atapinga kila kinachoitwa mungu na kila kitu ambacho watu huabudu, na kujiinua juu ya hivyo vyote, hata ataketi katika hekalu la Mungu na kujitangaza kuwa yeye ni Mungu.
sw.R: Msikubali mtu yeyote awadanganye kwa namna yoyote. Siku ile haitakuja mpaka kwanza kuwe na uasi mkubwa dhidi ya Mungu, na mpaka yule mtu anayeasi sheria zote za Mungu atokee. Yeye anaelekea kwenye maangamizi. \v 4 Atapigana na kila kitu ambacho watu hukiita mungu au hukiabudu. Atasema kwamba yeye ni mkuu kuliko vyote hivyo. Hata ataketi katika hekalu la Mungu na kusema kwamba yeye ni Mungu.

decisions.choice: [that day will not come] unless: the main clause is left unsaid
decisions.reason: The Greek gives only the condition; the obvious conclusion, "that day will not come", is left for the reader to supply from verse 2.

decisions.choice: the rebellion: a final, known revolt against God
alternatives: a departure of believers from the earth
decisions.reason: ἀποστασία means rebellion or defection, in the Greek Old Testament revolt against God (Joshua 22:22). The article marks it as the rebellion Paul had taught them about (verse 5). Some have read it as the departure of the church from the world, but the word has the sense of revolt elsewhere.

decisions.choice: the man of lawlessness, the son of destruction: one who embodies defiance of God and is doomed
decisions.reason: "Man of" and "son of" are Hebrew ways of saying what a person is marked by: he is lawlessness in person, and he is destined for destruction (John 17:12 uses "son of destruction" of Judas). The letter does not name him, and the many identifications readers have proposed go beyond what it says.

decisions.choice: exalting himself above every god, sitting in God's temple: the arrogant rulers of Daniel and the prophets
decisions.reason: The words echo the king of Daniel 11:36, who "will exalt himself above every god", and the ruler of Tyre who said "I am a god, I sit in the seat of God" (Ezekiel 28:2). Jewish memory held Antiochus IV, who set up a pagan altar in the temple in 167 BC, and the emperor Gaius, who in AD 40 ordered his statue placed there.

decisions.choice: the temple of God
alternatives: a picture of God's dwelling, or of the church (1 Corinthians 3:16)
decisions.reason: ναὸν is the word for the sanctuary. The temple in Jerusalem was standing when Paul wrote, and he may mean it; or the language may picture a claim to God's own place, without a particular building in view.

decisions.choice: [that day will not come]
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves the main clause to be understood (m1).

decisions.choice: the one doomed to destruction (B); He is headed for destruction (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain the idiom (m3).

decisions.choice: a great rebellion against God; the man who rebels against all of God's laws
alternatives: the rebellion; the man of lawlessness
decisions.reason: Readable says what the rebellion and lawlessness are (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: l’homme de l’iniquité (L); l’homme sans loi (B); l’homme qui méprise toutes les lois de Dieu (R); the same in 2:7-8 ("le mystère de l’iniquité", "celui qui est sans loi")
decisions.reason: The word is defiance of God's law (m3). Literal keeps the abstract noun with "iniquité", the established French word for it; Balanced says "sans loi", which also serves for "the lawless one" in verse 8; Readable explains. "Anarchie" would suggest political disorder.

decisions.choice: la rébellion (L), la grande rébellion (B); une grande révolte contre Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: French "apostasie" means abandoning one's faith, which narrows the sense; the meaning decision is a final revolt against God (m2), as the English "rebellion" says.

decisions.choice: el hombre de la iniquidad (L); el hombre de la maldad (B); el hombre que se rebela contra todas las leyes de Dios (R)
decisions.reason: The project renders anomia "iniquidad" at Literal and "maldad" at Balanced and Readable; the same words are used for "the mystery of lawlessness" (verse 7) and "the lawless one" ("el inicuo", "el malvado", verse 8), so that readers see they belong together.

decisions.choice: el hijo de la perdición (L); el que está destinado a la destrucción (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew-style "son of" means one marked out for something (meaning decision); Literal keeps the idiom with the familiar "perdición", Balanced says what it means.

decisions.choice: ukengeufu (L, B); uasi mkubwa dhidi ya Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: Two Greek words would both be "uasi" in Swahili: the rebellion (apostasia) and lawlessness (anomia, "uasi" as in Romans 6:19). Literal and Balanced keep them apart with "ukengeufu" (falling away, revolt from God) for the first, so "mtu wa uasi" can keep the project's word for lawlessness through verses 3-8. Readable explains both, as the English Readable does. For review by a native speaker: "ukengeufu" is a church word that some readers may not know.

decisions.choice: mtu wa uasi; yule mwasi (verse 8)
decisions.reason: "Uasi" is the project's word for lawlessness (anomia), and the lawless one of verse 8 is "yule mwasi" (the rebel against God's law), so the man, his mystery (verse 7) and his name stay one family of words.

source.text: οὐ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ἔτι ὢν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ταῦτα ἔλεγον ὑμῖν;

records.literal_gloss: Not do you remember that still being with you these things I was telling you?

en.L: Do you not remember that while I was still with you I was telling you these things?
en.B: Surely you remember: I kept telling you this while I was still with you.
en.R: Do you remember? When I was still with you, I told you these things.

fr.L: Ne vous souvenez-vous pas que, lorsque j’étais encore auprès de vous, je vous disais cela ?
fr.B: Vous vous en souvenez sûrement : je vous le répétais quand j’étais encore avec vous.
fr.R: Vous vous rappelez ? Quand j’étais encore avec vous, je vous ai dit ces choses.

es.L: ¿No {{plural_you:recuerdan|recordáis}} que, estando todavía con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} decía estas cosas?
es.B: Sin duda {{plural_you:recuerdan|recordáis}} que {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} decía una y otra vez cuando todavía estaba con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: ¿{{plural_you:Se acuerdan|Os acordáis}}? Cuando todavía estaba con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} dije estas cosas.

sw.L: Je, hamkumbuki kwamba nilipokuwa bado pamoja nanyi nilikuwa nikiwaambia mambo haya?
sw.B: Hakika mnakumbuka: niliwaambia jambo hili tena na tena nilipokuwa bado pamoja nanyi.
sw.R: Je, mnakumbuka? Nilipokuwa bado pamoja nanyi, niliwaambia mambo haya.

decisions.choice: I kept telling you: Paul himself, more than once
decisions.reason: The imperfect ἔλεγον and the singular "I" show that Paul had taught them about this in person and often. That is why he can be brief here, and why some of what he says is hard for later readers: they knew what he meant (verse 6).

decisions.choice: Surely you remember
decisions.reason: The question expects "yes"; Balanced says so.

source.text: καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε, εἰς τὸ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἑαυτοῦ καιρῷ·

records.literal_gloss: And now the restraining [thing] you know, so that to be revealed him in the of himself time;

en.L: And you know what is restraining [him] now, so that he will be revealed in his own time.
en.B: And you know what is holding him back now, so that he will be revealed only when his time comes.
en.R: You know what is stopping him from appearing now. He will appear only at the time that has been set for him.

fr.L: Et maintenant vous savez ce qui [le] retient, pour qu’il soit révélé en son propre temps.
fr.B: Et vous savez ce qui le retient maintenant, pour qu’il ne soit révélé qu’au moment fixé pour lui.
fr.R: Vous savez ce qui l’empêche de paraître maintenant. Il ne paraîtra qu’au moment qui a été fixé pour lui.

es.L: Y ahora {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} lo que [lo] detiene, para que sea manifestado a su debido tiempo.
es.B: Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} qué es lo que ahora lo retiene, para que se manifieste solo cuando le llegue su momento.
es.R: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} qué es lo que ahora le impide aparecer. Aparecerá solo en el momento que se le ha fijado.

sw.L: Na sasa mnajua kinachomzuia, ili afunuliwe katika wakati wake mwenyewe.
sw.B: Nanyi mnajua kinachomzuia sasa, ili afunuliwe wakati wake utakapofika tu.
sw.R: Mnajua kinachomzuia asitokee sasa. Atatokea tu wakati uliowekwa kwa ajili yake.

decisions.choice: what is restraining: a power holding back the lawless one, which the Thessalonians knew and we do not
alternatives: the Roman empire and its emperor
decisions.reason: κατέχον is neuter here ("what restrains"), and in verse 7 masculine ("the one who restrains"), so it may be a force with a person behind it. Paul says the Thessalonians know what it is; he does not say. All the proposals listed are guesses. κατέχω can also mean "hold sway", which would change the picture, though "restrain" fits "until he is taken out of the way" (verse 7).

decisions.choice: in his own time: the time set for him
decisions.reason: The lawless one cannot appear before his appointed time: even his coming is under God's control.

decisions.choice: what is stopping him from appearing
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the sense without naming the restrainer (m1).

decisions.choice: lo que lo detiene (L); lo que lo retiene (B); lo que le impide aparecer (R)
decisions.reason: The word in verse 6 is neuter, "what restrains", and in verse 7 masculine, "the one who restrains" (meaning decisions); Spanish keeps the shift with "lo que" here and "el que" in verse 7. What it was is not known (footnoted meaning decision), so no level names it.

decisions.choice: kinachomzuia (verse 6); yule anayezuia (verse 7)
decisions.reason: The Greek calls the restrainer "what restrains" (neuter) here and "the one who restrains" (masculine) in verse 7 (meaning decisions). Swahili keeps the difference with the thing-class "kinachomzuia" here and the personal "yule anayezuia" in verse 7, without saying who or what it is.

source.text: τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀνομίας· μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται.

records.literal_gloss: The for mystery already is at work of the lawlessness; only the [one] restraining now until out of [the] midst he is gone.

en.L: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only [there is] the one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
en.B: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but only until the one who now holds it back is taken out of the way.
en.R: The mystery of lawlessness is already at work in the world, in ways people cannot see. But someone is holding it back now, until that one is taken out of the way.

fr.L: Car le mystère de l’iniquité est déjà à l’œuvre ; seulement [il y a] celui qui retient maintenant, jusqu’à ce qu’il soit écarté du milieu.
fr.B: Car le mystère de l’iniquité est déjà à l’œuvre, mais seulement jusqu’à ce que celui qui le retient maintenant soit écarté.
fr.R: Le mystère de la révolte contre Dieu est déjà à l’œuvre dans le monde, d’une manière que les gens ne peuvent pas voir. Mais quelqu’un le retient maintenant, jusqu’à ce que celui-là soit écarté.

es.L: Porque el misterio de la iniquidad ya está actuando; solo [está] el que ahora [lo] detiene, hasta que sea quitado de en medio.
es.B: Porque el misterio de la maldad ya está actuando, pero solo hasta que sea quitado de en medio el que ahora lo retiene.
es.R: El misterio de la maldad ya está actuando en el mundo, de formas que la gente no puede ver. Pero alguien lo está reteniendo ahora, hasta que ese alguien sea quitado de en medio.

sw.L: Kwa maana siri ya uasi tayari inatenda kazi; ila [yupo] yule anayezuia sasa, mpaka atakapoondolewa katikati.
sw.B: Kwa maana siri ya uasi tayari inafanya kazi, lakini ni mpaka yule anayeizuia sasa atakapoondolewa njiani.
sw.R: Siri ya uasi tayari inafanya kazi ulimwenguni, kwa njia ambazo watu hawawezi kuziona. Lakini kuna mtu anayeizuia sasa, mpaka atakapoondolewa njiani.

decisions.choice: the mystery of lawlessness: rebellion against God at work in hidden ways
decisions.reason: Elsewhere μυστήριον is God's plan, once hidden and now made known (Colossians 1:26). Here, as a dark counterpart, it is lawlessness already at work beneath the surface, before it shows itself openly in the lawless one.

decisions.choice: until he is taken out of the way: removed
decisions.reason: ἐκ μέσου ("out of the midst") means removed, out of the way. Who removes him, and how, is not said.

decisions.choice: the one who restrains: masculine here (see verse 6)
decisions.reason: See the note on verse 6.

decisions.choice: in ways people cannot see
decisions.reason: Readable says why it is called a mystery (m1); the key term "mystery" stays at every level.

source.text: καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ ἄνομος, ὃν ὁ κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἀνελεῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ καταργήσει τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ, οὗ ἐστιν ἡ παρουσία κατ’ ἐνέργειαν τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν ψεύδους καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ἀπάτῃ ἀδικίας τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις, ἀνθ’ ὧν τὴν ἀγάπην τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἐδέξαντο εἰς τὸ σωθῆναι αὐτούς·

records.literal_gloss: And then will be revealed the lawless [one], whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of the mouth of him and will bring to nothing by the appearing of the coming of him, \v 9 whose is the coming according to [the] working of the Satan with all power and signs and wonders of falsehood \v 10 and with all deceit of unrighteousness for those perishing, because the love of the truth not they received so as to be saved them.

en.L: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming. \v 9 [The lawless one's] coming is by the working of Satan, with every [kind of] power and signs and wonders of falsehood, \v 10 and with every deception of wickedness for those who are perishing, because they did not receive the love of the truth so as to be saved.
en.B: Then the lawless one will be unveiled, and the Lord Jesus will destroy him with the breath of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth and bring him to nothing by the brightness of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming. \v 9 The lawless one comes by Satan's working, with all kinds of power, with false signs and wonders, \v 10 and with every evil trick to deceive those who are on the way to ruin. They are lost because they would not welcome the love of the truth, which would have saved them.
en.R: Then the lawless man will appear. But the Lord Jesus will destroy him just by breathing on him, and will bring him to an end by the brightness of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming. \v 9 Satan will give the lawless man power to come and to do all kinds of powerful things. He will do signs and wonders, but they will all be lies. \v 10 He will use every kind of evil trick to fool people who are on the way to destruction. They will be destroyed because they did not want to love the truth, which would have saved them.

fr.L: Et alors sera révélé celui qui est sans loi, que le Seigneur Jésus fera périr par le souffle de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche et réduira à néant par l’apparition de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue, \v 9 lui dont la venue se fait selon l’action de Satan, avec toute [sorte de] puissance, et de signes et de prodiges de mensonge, \v 10 et avec toute tromperie de l’injustice pour ceux qui périssent, parce qu’ils n’ont pas accueilli l’amour de la vérité pour être sauvés.
fr.B: Alors l’homme sans loi sera dévoilé, et le Seigneur Jésus le fera périr par le souffle de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche et l’anéantira par l’éclat de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue. \v 9 L’homme sans loi vient par l’action de Satan, avec toutes sortes de puissances, de signes et de prodiges mensongers, \v 10 et avec toutes les ruses du mal pour tromper ceux qui vont à leur perte. Ils se perdent parce qu’ils n’ont pas voulu accueillir l’amour de la vérité, qui les aurait sauvés.
fr.R: Alors l’homme qui méprise les lois de Dieu paraîtra. Mais le Seigneur Jésus le détruira simplement en soufflant sur lui, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mettra fin à son pouvoir par l’éclat de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue. \v 9 Satan donnera à cet homme le pouvoir de venir et de faire toutes sortes de choses puissantes. Il fera des signes et des prodiges, mais ce ne seront que des mensonges. \v 10 Il utilisera toutes sortes de ruses mauvaises pour tromper les gens qui vont vers leur destruction. Ils seront détruits parce qu’ils n’ont pas voulu aimer la vérité, qui les aurait sauvés.

es.L: Y entonces será manifestado el inicuo, a quien el Señor Jesús matará con el aliento de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca y destruirá con el resplandor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida. \v 9 La venida [del inicuo] es según la acción de Satanás, con todo poder y señales y prodigios de mentira, \v 10 y con todo engaño de injusticia para los que se pierden, porque no recibieron el amor de la verdad para ser salvos.
es.B: Entonces se manifestará el malvado, y el Señor Jesús lo destruirá con el aliento de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca y lo reducirá a nada con el resplandor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida. \v 9 El malvado vendrá por la acción de Satanás, con toda clase de poder, con señales y prodigios falsos, \v 10 y con toda clase de trampas malvadas para engañar a los que van camino de la perdición. Se pierden porque no quisieron acoger el amor a la verdad, que los habría salvado.
es.R: Entonces aparecerá ese hombre malvado. Pero el Señor Jesús lo destruirá con solo soplar sobre él, y le pondrá fin con el resplandor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida. \v 9 Satanás le dará poder al malvado para venir y hacer toda clase de cosas poderosas. Hará señales y prodigios, pero todos serán mentira. \v 10 Usará toda clase de trampas malvadas para engañar a la gente que va camino de la destrucción. Serán destruidos porque no quisieron amar la verdad, que los habría salvado.

sw.L: Na hapo ndipo atafunuliwa yule mwasi, ambaye Bwana Yesu atamuua kwa pumzi ya kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} na kumbatilisha kwa kuonekana kwa kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. \v 9 Kuja kwa [yule mwasi] ni kwa utendaji wa Shetani, pamoja na kila [aina ya] nguvu na ishara na maajabu ya uongo, \v 10 na pamoja na kila udanganyifu wa udhalimu kwa wale wanaopotea, kwa sababu hawakuukubali upendo wa kweli ili waokolewe.
sw.B: Hapo ndipo yule mwasi atafunuliwa, naye Bwana Yesu atamwangamiza kwa pumzi ya kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} na kumkomesha kwa mng'ao wa kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. \v 9 Yule mwasi anakuja kwa utendaji wa Shetani, akiwa na nguvu za kila aina, na ishara na maajabu ya uongo, \v 10 na kila hila ovu ya kuwadanganya wale walio njiani kuelekea maangamizi. Wanapotea kwa sababu hawakukubali kuupokea upendo wa kweli, ambao ungewaokoa.
sw.R: Kisha yule mtu mwasi atatokea. Lakini Bwana Yesu atamwangamiza kwa kumpulizia tu, na kumkomesha kwa mng'ao wa kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. \v 9 Shetani atampa yule mtu mwasi nguvu za kuja na kufanya mambo ya nguvu ya kila aina. Atafanya ishara na maajabu, lakini yote yatakuwa uongo. \v 10 Atatumia kila aina ya hila ovu kuwadanganya watu walio njiani kuelekea maangamizi. Wataangamia kwa sababu hawakutaka kuipenda kweli, ambayo ingewaokoa.

decisions.choice: with the breath of his mouth: Isaiah 11:4
decisions.reason: The coming king of Isaiah 11:4 "will kill the wicked with the breath of his lips". A word from Jesus is enough.

decisions.choice: bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming
decisions.reason: καταργέω is to make powerless, abolish. ἐπιφανείᾳ is a shining appearance, used of a god showing himself or a ruler's arrival: his coming in splendor ends the lawless one.

decisions.choice: whose coming: the lawless one's, a counterfeit of Christ's
decisions.reason: οὗ refers to the lawless one. Paul uses for his arrival the same word, παρουσία, as for Christ's coming: a mocking imitation.

decisions.choice: power, signs and wonders of falsehood: all of them serving the lie
decisions.reason: ψεύδους ("of falsehood") most likely describes all three: real or not, they serve deception (Mark 13:22).

decisions.choice: those who are perishing: on the way to ruin
decisions.reason: The present ἀπολλυμένοις describes people heading for destruction (1 Corinthians 1:18).

decisions.choice: they did not receive the love of the truth: they refused the gospel
decisions.reason: The truth is the gospel (verses 12-13). They are not merely misled: they would not welcome what would have saved them.

decisions.choice: [The lawless one's]
decisions.reason: Literal names the one referred to (m3).

decisions.choice: just by breathing on him
alternatives: with the breath of his mouth
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: lui dont la venue se fait selon l’action de Satan
alternatives: [Sa] venue est selon l’action de Satan
decisions.reason: French can keep the Greek relative clause ("whose coming") with "lui dont", which names the lawless one without a bracket; the English Literal supplies the name instead.

decisions.choice: venida (of Christ and of the lawless one)
decisions.reason: Paul uses the same word for the coming of Christ and the coming of the lawless one, whose coming is a counterfeit of Christ's (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep "venida" and "vendrá" for both.

decisions.choice: el resplandor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida
decisions.reason: The word is the bright appearing of a god or ruler; "resplandor" keeps that picture, as the English Balanced "brightness" does.

decisions.choice: kuja (for both comings)
decisions.reason: Paul uses the same word for Christ's coming (verse 8) and the lawless one's (verse 9), the second a counterfeit of the first (meaning decision). Swahili keeps one word, "kuja", for both, as in 1 Thessalonians.

source.text: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο πέμπει αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ἐνέργειαν πλάνης εἰς τὸ πιστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς τῷ ψεύδει, ἵνα κριθῶσιν πάντες οἱ μὴ πιστεύσαντες τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἀλλὰ εὐδοκήσαντες τῇ ἀδικίᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: And because of this sends to them the God [a] working of delusion so that to believe them the lie, \v 12 so that may be judged all those not having believed the truth but having taken pleasure in the unrighteousness.

en.L: And for this reason God sends them a working of delusion so that they believe the lie, \v 12 so that all may be judged who did not believe the truth but took pleasure in unrighteousness.
en.B: That is why God sends them a deluding power, so that they put their trust in the lie, \v 12 and judgment comes on all who refused to believe the truth and chose to take pleasure in what is wrong.
en.R: So God sends them a power that fools them, and they believe what is false. \v 12 Then God will judge everyone who did not believe the truth but enjoyed doing wrong.

fr.L: Et c’est pourquoi Dieu leur envoie une puissance d’égarement, pour qu’ils croient au mensonge, \v 12 afin que soient jugés tous ceux qui n’ont pas cru à la vérité, mais ont pris plaisir à l’injustice.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi Dieu leur envoie une puissance qui les égare, pour qu’ils se fient au mensonge, \v 12 et que le jugement tombe sur tous ceux qui ont refusé de croire la vérité et ont choisi de prendre plaisir au mal.
fr.R: Alors Dieu leur envoie une puissance qui les trompe, et ils croient ce qui est faux. \v 12 Puis Dieu jugera tous ceux qui n’ont pas cru la vérité, mais qui ont aimé faire le mal.

es.L: Y por esto Dios les envía una fuerza de engaño, para que crean la mentira, \v 12 a fin de que sean juzgados todos los que no creyeron a la verdad, sino que se complacieron en la injusticia.
es.B: Por eso Dios les envía un poder engañoso, para que pongan su confianza en la mentira \v 12 y caiga el juicio sobre todos los que se negaron a creer la verdad y prefirieron complacerse en el mal.
es.R: Por eso Dios les envía un poder que los engaña, y creen lo que es falso. \v 12 Entonces Dios juzgará a todos los que no creyeron la verdad, sino que disfrutaron haciendo el mal.

sw.L: Na kwa sababu hii Mungu anawapelekea nguvu ya upotovu ili waamini ule uongo, \v 12 ili wahukumiwe wote wasioiamini kweli bali walifurahia udhalimu.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu Mungu anawapelekea nguvu inayowapotosha, ili wauamini ule uongo, \v 12 na hukumu iwajie wote waliokataa kuiamini kweli na badala yake wakachagua kufurahia yaliyo maovu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Mungu anawapelekea nguvu inayowadanganya, nao wanaamini yasiyo kweli. \v 12 Kisha Mungu atamhukumu kila mtu ambaye hakuiamini kweli, bali alifurahia kufanya mabaya.

decisions.choice: God sends them delusion: his judgment gives them over to what they chose
decisions.reason: Those who refused the truth (verse 10) are handed over to the lie they preferred, as in Romans 1:24-28, where God "gave them over", and 1 Kings 22:22-23. God's sending is a judgment on their choice, not its cause.

decisions.choice: the lie: the great lie set against the truth
decisions.reason: The article points to a particular lie, most likely the lawless one's claim to be God (verse 4), the opposite of "the truth".

decisions.choice: judged: condemned
decisions.reason: κρίνω here means judged and found guilty.

source.text: Ἡμεῖς δὲ ὀφείλομεν εὐχαριστεῖν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ κυρίου, ὅτι εἵλατο ὑμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ἀπαρχὴν εἰς σωτηρίαν ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος καὶ πίστει ἀληθείας, εἰς ὃ ἐκάλεσεν ὑμᾶς διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἡμῶν, εἰς περιποίησιν δόξης τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: We but ought to give thanks to the God always concerning you, brothers having been loved by [the] Lord, because chose you the God [as] firstfruits for salvation in sanctification of [the] Spirit and faith in [the] truth, \v 14 to which he called you through the gospel of us, for [the] obtaining of [the] glory of the Lord of us Jesus Christ.

en.L: But we ought always to give thanks to God for you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} loved by [the] Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits for salvation, through sanctification by [the] Spirit and faith in [the] truth, \v 14 to which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called you through our gospel, for obtaining the glory of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: But we must always thank God for you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} whom the Lord loves, because God chose you, as the first of a harvest, to be saved, through the Spirit who makes you holy and through your faith in the truth. \v 14 To this {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called you when we brought you the gospel, so that you would come to possess the glory of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: But we must always thank God for you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}. The Lord loves you. God chose you to be among the first to be saved. He made you holy by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit, and you put your faith in the truth. \v 14 God called you to this when we told you the good news. He did this so that you could share in the glory of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

fr.L: Mais nous, nous devons toujours rendre grâce à Dieu pour vous, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} aimés du Seigneur, parce que Dieu vous a choisis comme prémices pour le salut, par la sanctification de l’Esprit et la foi en la vérité, \v 14 à quoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a appelés par notre Évangile, pour que vous obteniez la gloire de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Mais nous devons toujours remercier Dieu pour vous, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} que le Seigneur aime, car Dieu vous a choisis comme les premiers fruits de la moisson, pour être sauvés par l’Esprit qui vous rend saints et par votre foi en la vérité. \v 14 C’est à cela qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a appelés quand nous vous avons apporté l’Évangile, pour que vous possédiez un jour la gloire de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Mais nous devons toujours remercier Dieu pour vous, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}. Le Seigneur vous aime. Dieu vous a choisis pour être parmi les premiers à être sauvés. Il vous a rendus saints par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit, et vous avez mis votre foi dans la vérité. \v 14 Dieu vous a appelés à cela quand nous vous avons annoncé la bonne nouvelle. Il l’a fait pour que vous ayez part à la gloire de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.

es.L: Pero nosotros debemos dar gracias a Dios siempre por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hermanos amados por [el] Señor, porque Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} escogió como primicias para salvación, mediante la santificación por [el] Espíritu y la fe en [la] verdad, \v 14 a lo cual {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó por medio de nuestro evangelio, para alcanzar la gloria de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: Pero nosotros siempre tenemos que dar gracias a Dios por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hermanos a quienes el Señor ama, porque Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} escogió como los primeros frutos de la cosecha para ser salvos, por medio del Espíritu que {{plural_you:los|os}} hace santos y de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe en la verdad. \v 14 A esto {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó cuando {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciamos el evangelio, para que {{plural_you:llegaran|llegarais}} a poseer la gloria de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.R: Pero siempre debemos dar gracias a Dios por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hermanos. El Señor {{plural_you:los|os}} ama. Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} escogió para que {{plural_you:estuvieran|estuvierais}} entre los primeros en ser salvados. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} hizo santos por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:pusieron|pusisteis}} {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe en la verdad. \v 14 Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó a esto cuando {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciamos la buena noticia. Lo hizo para que {{plural_you:pudieran|pudierais}} compartir la gloria de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Lakini sisi imetupasa kumshukuru Mungu siku zote kwa ajili yenu, ndugu mliopendwa na Bwana, kwa sababu Mungu aliwachagua [kama] malimbuko kwa ajili ya wokovu, katika utakaso wa Roho na imani katika kweli, \v 14 ambayo kwa ajili yake aliwaita kupitia Injili yetu, ili mpate utukufu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Lakini sisi imetupasa kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu siku zote, ndugu mnaopendwa na Bwana, kwa sababu Mungu aliwachagua, kama malimbuko ya mavuno, ili mwokolewe kupitia Roho anayewafanya watakatifu na kupitia imani yenu katika kweli. \v 14 Aliwaitia jambo hili tulipowaletea Injili, ili mpate kumiliki utukufu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Lakini tunapaswa kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu siku zote, ndugu. Bwana anawapenda. Mungu aliwachagua mwe miongoni mwa watu wa kwanza kuokolewa. Aliwafanya watakatifu kwa Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, nanyi mkaiamini kweli. \v 14 Mungu aliwaita kwa ajili ya jambo hili tulipowaeleza Habari Njema. Alifanya hivyo ili mpate kushiriki utukufu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "as firstfruits"
decisions.reason: The two readings differ by a single letter in the Greek capitals of the oldest manuscripts, and both have good support. "Firstfruits", the first of a harvest offered to God, fits Paul's usage (Romans 16:5; 1 Corinthians 16:15): the Thessalonians are among the first believers in Macedonia. "From the beginning" would stress that God chose them before time. Reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: through the Spirit's work of making holy and through faith in the truth
decisions.reason: God's side and theirs: the Spirit sets them apart for God, and they believe the truth (contrast verse 12).

decisions.choice: loved by the Lord: Jesus
decisions.reason: "The Lord" is Jesus, set beside "God chose you". The words recall Deuteronomy 33:12, "the beloved of the LORD".

decisions.choice: obtaining the glory: coming to possess it
decisions.reason: περιποίησιν is the word of 1 Thessalonians 5:9, "obtaining salvation". They will share the glory of Christ (1:10, 1:12).

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The letter is to the whole church, women and men; "brothers" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: as the first of a harvest (B); among the first (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain "firstfruits" (m1).

decisions.choice: prémices (L); les premiers fruits de la moisson (B)
decisions.reason: "Prémices" is the French word for the first part of a harvest offered to God; Balanced spells out the picture, as the English "first of a harvest" does (m1).

decisions.choice: como primicias (L); como los primeros frutos de la cosecha (B)
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "as firstfruits" (footnoted meaning decision); Literal uses the Bible word "primicias", Balanced explains it as the first fruits of a harvest, as the English does.

decisions.choice: malimbuko
decisions.reason: "Malimbuko" (the first of the harvest, offered to God) is the word Romans 8:23, 16:5 and 1 Corinthians 15:20 use; Balanced adds "ya mavuno" (of the harvest), as the English Balanced does. Readable says "miongoni mwa watu wa kwanza" (among the first).

source.text: ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, στήκετε, καὶ κρατεῖτε τὰς παραδόσεις ἃς ἐδιδάχθητε εἴτε διὰ λόγου εἴτε δι’ ἐπιστολῆς ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: So then, brothers, stand firm, and hold fast the traditions which you were taught whether through word or through letter of us.

en.L: So then, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, stand firm and hold fast the traditions that you were taught, whether by word [of mouth] or by our letter.
en.B: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, keep standing firm, and keep a firm grip on the traditions you were taught by us, whether we spoke them in person or wrote them in our letter.
en.R: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, stand strong. Hold on to the teachings we gave you, both what we said to you in person and what we wrote to you in our letter.

fr.L: Ainsi donc, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, tenez ferme et retenez les traditions que vous avez apprises, soit par la parole, soit par notre lettre.
fr.B: Ainsi, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, continuez à tenir ferme et gardez fermement les traditions que nous vous avons enseignées, soit de vive voix, soit par notre lettre.
fr.R: Alors, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, restez solides. Gardez les enseignements que nous vous avons donnés, ce que nous vous avons dit en personne et ce que nous vous avons écrit dans notre lettre.

es.L: Así que, hermanos, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} firmes y {{plural_you:retengan|retened}} las tradiciones que {{plural_you:les|os}} fueron enseñadas, ya sea de palabra o por carta nuestra.
es.B: Así que, hermanos, {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} firmes y {{plural_you:aférrense|aferraos}} a las tradiciones que {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñamos, ya sea de palabra o por nuestra carta.
es.R: Así que, hermanos, {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} fuertes. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} las enseñanzas que {{plural_you:les|os}} dimos, tanto lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} dijimos en persona como lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} escribimos en nuestra carta.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo basi, ndugu, simameni imara, na mshike kwa nguvu mapokeo mliyofundishwa, iwe kwa neno [la mdomo] au kwa barua yetu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, endeleeni kusimama imara, na myashike kwa nguvu mapokeo tuliyowafundisha, iwe tuliyasema ana kwa ana au tuliyaandika katika barua yetu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, simameni imara. Shikilieni mafundisho tuliyowapa, yale tuliyowaambia ana kwa ana na yale tuliyowaandikia katika barua yetu.

decisions.choice: traditions: the teaching handed on by the apostles
decisions.reason: παραδόσεις is teaching passed on (1 Corinthians 11:2; 15:3). Unlike the "human tradition" of Colossians 2:8, this tradition comes from the Lord through his messengers.

decisions.choice: our letter: the letter they had received
decisions.reason: Most likely 1 Thessalonians. Paul's genuine teaching, spoken or written, is the answer to the false claims of verse 2.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The letter is to the whole church, women and men; "brothers" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: las tradiciones (L, B); las enseñanzas (R)
decisions.reason: The word is teaching handed on by the apostles (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep "tradiciones", which in Spanish can suggest human custom, so Readable says "enseñanzas".

decisions.choice: mapokeo (L, B); mafundisho (R)
decisions.reason: "Mapokeo" (what has been received and handed on) is the word 1 Corinthians 11:2 uses for the apostles' teaching; Readable says "mafundisho" (teachings), as the English Readable does. "Desturi" (customs) would suggest habits, not teaching.

source.text: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς καὶ θεὸς ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν, ὁ ἀγαπήσας ἡμᾶς καὶ δοὺς παράκλησιν αἰωνίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα ἀγαθὴν ἐν χάριτι, παρακαλέσαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας καὶ στηρίξαι ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ ἀγαθῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Himself now the Lord of us Jesus Christ and God the Father of us, the [one] having loved us and having given eternal comfort and hope good in grace, \v 17 may comfort of you the hearts and strengthen [them] in every work and word good.

en.L: Now may our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} and God our Father, who loved us and gave [us] eternal comfort and good hope by grace, \v 17 comfort your hearts and strengthen [them] in every good work and word.
en.B: Our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} and God our Father loved us and gave us eternal comfort and a good hope by grace. \v 17 May they comfort your hearts and steady them in every good deed and word.
en.R: Our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} and God our Father love us. Because of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, God has given us eternal comfort and a good hope. \v 17 We pray that they will encourage you and make you strong, so that you always do and say what is good.

fr.L: Or que notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} et Dieu notre Père, qui nous a aimés et [nous] a donné une consolation éternelle et une bonne espérance par grâce, \v 17 consolent vos cœurs et [les] affermissent en toute bonne œuvre et parole.
fr.B: Notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} et Dieu notre Père nous ont aimés et nous ont donné, par grâce, une consolation éternelle et une bonne espérance. \v 17 Qu’ils consolent vos cœurs et les affermissent en toute bonne action et en toute bonne parole.
fr.R: Notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} et Dieu notre Père nous aiment. Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, Dieu nous a donné un réconfort éternel et une bonne espérance. \v 17 Nous prions pour qu’ils vous encouragent et vous rendent forts, pour que vous fassiez et disiez toujours ce qui est bien.

es.L: Y que nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} mismo y Dios nuestro Padre, que nos amó y nos dio consuelo eterno y buena esperanza por gracia, \v 17 consuelen {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones y [los] afirmen en toda buena obra y palabra.
es.B: Nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} mismo y Dios nuestro Padre nos amaron y por gracia nos dieron consuelo eterno y una buena esperanza. \v 17 Que ellos consuelen {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones y los afirmen en toda buena obra y palabra.
es.R: Nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} mismo y Dios nuestro Padre nos aman. Por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, Dios nos ha dado consuelo eterno y una buena esperanza. \v 17 Pedimos que ellos {{plural_you:los|os}} animen y {{plural_you:los|os}} hagan fuertes, para que siempre {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} y {{plural_you:digan|digáis}} lo que es bueno.

sw.L: Basi Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} na Mungu Baba yetu, aliyetupenda na kutupa faraja ya milele na tumaini jema kwa neema, \v 17 aifariji mioyo yenu na kuiimarisha katika kila kazi na neno jema.
sw.B: Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, pamoja na Mungu Baba yetu aliyetupenda na kutupa faraja ya milele na tumaini jema kwa neema, \v 17 aifariji mioyo yenu na kuiimarisha katika kila tendo jema na kila neno jema.
sw.R: Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} na Mungu Baba yetu wanatupenda. Kwa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, Mungu ametupa faraja ya milele na tumaini jema. \v 17 Tunaomba kwamba wawatie moyo na kuwafanya imara, ili siku zote mfanye na kusema yaliyo mema.

decisions.choice: the Lord Jesus Christ and God the Father act as one
decisions.reason: Jesus is named first here, and the participles and verbs that follow are singular though both are their subject, as in 1 Thessalonians 3:11: what one does, the other does.

decisions.choice: eternal comfort: comfort that lasts into the age to come
decisions.reason: αἰωνίαν marks the comfort as belonging to the age to come: it does not fail when trouble comes.

decisions.choice: by grace: goes with "gave"
decisions.reason: The comfort and hope are a gift of God's free favor.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: Balanced and Readable divide the prayer into two sentences
decisions.reason: The Greek is one sentence; English reads more easily with the statement first and the prayer after.

decisions.choice: plural verbs "consolent", "affermissent"
decisions.reason: The Greek prayer has singular verbs for the Lord Jesus Christ and God the Father together (m1), as in 1 Thessalonians 3:11; French requires the plural after two subjects joined by "et".

decisions.choice: nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} mismo, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As in 1 Thessalonians 3:11, Spanish says "himself" with the adjective "mismo", which is not a pronoun, so it takes no span.

decisions.choice: que nos amó y nos dio
decisions.reason: The Greek participles are singular although they follow two names, as the meaning decision notes (they act as one); Literal keeps the singular, Balanced and Readable use the plural that Spanish needs.

decisions.choice: aifariji: singular verb (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Thessalonians 3:11, the Greek has two subjects and singular verbs, showing the Lord Jesus Christ and God the Father acting as one (meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep the singular, Balanced joining the Father with "pamoja na"; Readable uses the plural, as the English Readable does.
